lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R2-002 fixed the round-2 WARNING flagged by review at docs/adr/0050-gateship-supersedes-garboard-naming.md:76 (and its line-20 twin): the ADR asserted docs/positioning.md was still an out-of-cycle, operator-scheduled follow-up blocked on this ADR landing, but docs/positioning.md was in fact already rewritten to Gateship inside this same cycle by US-002 (commit a3df6786), and the PRD's own US-002 AC0 mandates it. Verified via grep that docs/positioning.md already uses Gateship pervasively (lines 3, 7, 15, 23, 33, 37, 47, 57, 60, 65, 69, 73, 77, 82) before editing. Fix: narrowed both line 20 and line 76 to state docs/positioning.md was rewritten within this cycle (CAM-434) and that only the README differentiation section (CAM-331) remains a genuine out-of-cycle, operator-scheduled follow-up. No other content touched; two-line diff, both in the 'Staged rename plan' bullet and the 'Consequences' section. All quality gates green: typecheck 0 errors, bun test 5665 pass / 0 fail, bun run check:all clean (file-size/debt-markers/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps all ok; only pre-existing non-blocking warnings carried over from US-R2-001: biome.json deprecated 'recommended' field, a few knip ignore-list hints, validate-agents-md KNOWN_MISSING informational notices). Next reviewer round should re-check remaining ADR-0050 findings from round 1/2 (e.g. lines 53-61 candidate-elimination sourcing, line 64 deckward attribution) if not already addressed by sibling US-R2-00x stories in this same PRD, and should re-sweep whether any other docs/adr prose still narrates the retired name outside the already-exempted historical/control-plane paths.
